name: Mirin
siboNotes: Small amounts are typically well tolerated. The alcohol content may help with bacterial overgrowth, but the fructose can feed bacteria in larger quantities.
preparationTips: Use sparingly as a flavor enhancer in marinades and glazes
Heat during cooking to evaporate some alcohol content
Mix with low FODMAP soy sauce for balanced umami
Store in refrigerator after opening to maintain quality
alternatives: Rice vinegar with a pinch of sugar
Dry white wine with maple syrup (small amounts)
Tamari or soy sauce for umami without sweetness
Sake with a touch of brown sugar
nutritionalHighlights: Contains small amounts of B vitamins from rice fermentation
Low in sodium compared to soy sauce
